notes.title: Update Notes 3/10/2022
notes.notes:
We have released a new version of Rune Factory 4 Special.

This update adds support for Simplified Chinese text in the game.

notes.title: Update Notes 12/17/2021
notes.notes:
We have released a new version of Rune Factory 4 Special.

Build ID: 7903645

This update addresses the following issues:
-Debug-related functions are no longer accessible in the game
-Remapping the Escape action now works correctly for controllers
-Controllers can now select RESET or Done in the button config menu in the launcher
-Minor launcher text fixes.
